features.benefit: Compare check-ins across co-located events and see attendees who cross over.
features.what: The total check-in and check-out graph compares co-located events and shows crossover check-ins, filterable by badge origin.
features.detail: The total check-in and check-out graph compares co-located events and shows crossover check-ins, filterable by badge origin.
stories: Attendance: Organizer can compare Check-ins across co-located Events and view Crossover Check-ins in Total Check-In / Check-Out graph

features.title: Faster report exports
features.benefit: Download session and booking reports faster and more reliably on large events.
features.what: The by-session export was reworked to run in the background more reliably, and the by-booking report loads each page with a fixed set of queries, however many orders the event has.
features.detail: The by-session export was reworked to run in the background more reliably, and the by-booking report loads each page with a fixed set of queries.
stories: bySession export rework
N+1 query loop in By Booking report (SessionOrdersRepository)

features.title: Google Analytics 4 support
features.benefit: Track event website traffic with Google Analytics 4.
features.what: GA4 tracking works again on event websites. The Google Analytics ID field in the admin panel checks the GA4 format and has placeholder and help text, and leaving it empty turns tracking off.
features.detail: GA4 tracking works again on event websites, and the Google Analytics ID field in the admin panel validates the GA4 format, with placeholder and help text; leaving it empty turns tracking off.
stories: Restoring Google Analytics Support: Enhancements for GA4 Integration and Validation
Google Analytics field front-end validation

features.title: Meeting outcome columns in reports
features.benefit: See whether meetings took place and how likely they are to lead to business.
features.what: The meetings report and the custom meeting wizard report include business transaction likelihood and meeting did not take place columns, for every rated meeting.
features.detail: The meetings report and custom meeting wizard report include business transaction likelihood and meeting did not take place columns.
stories: Enhancing Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard Report: Adding Business Transaction Likelihood and Meeting Did Not Take Place Columns

features.title: Sponsorship and engagement reporting
features.benefit: Measure sponsor performance by asset in a sponsorships dashboard.
features.what: A sponsorships dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate per sponsor and asset, with sponsor KPI cards, backed by a new sponsor interactions report.
features.detail: A sponsorships dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate per sponsor and asset, backed by a new sponsor interactions report, and existing dashboard graphs were refined.
stories: [Dashboard] Sponsorships Deep Dive — Sponsor Performance by Asset (R21)
[Statistics Reports] New SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport — paginated sponsor interaction rows from sponsor_statistics
Address Informa Analytics Display Feedback #2 (graph-level fixes & additions)
